d:
Bihar BJP Padayatra : bihar men loktantr aur voting raits ke mudde par siyasi halchal tej hone ja rahi hai. bijepi 28 aktubar ko patna men ‘loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao’ abhiyan ke tahat padyatra nikalegi. mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri is padyatra ki shuruaat karenge.
Vahin, RJD aur kangres ne voting raits, vot chori, mahangaee aur berojgari jaise muddon par NDA ko gherne ki ranniti banaee hai. aise men bihar ki rajniti men aarop-pratyarop aur siyasi shakti pradarshan dekhne ko mil sakta hai.
